Chale Chalo is a very powerful song with engaging vocals by Srinivas & A. R. Rahman, which will charge you up with its brilliant tempo and background score. Uplift yourself with the cast of Lagaan and Chale Chalo with Aamir Khan and Gracy Singh now.
